npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

trainer/30032-1.htm.text: Priest Yohanes: The goddess Einhasad is the source of goodness, mercy and justice. Like my father before us, my twin brother Baulro and I serve her with our whole hearts. Baulro follows the path of a Magister rather than a Priest, but his faith is as strong as mine.

Q00151_CureForFever/30032-01.html.text: Priest Yohanes: Elias has sent you, I presume. I will hurry and make the medicine from the Poison Sacs you have brought me. Anyhow, Elias must be devastated at the turn of events that has happened to his students. But I think that Elias is largely responsible... taking the students to such a danger…

Q00151_CureForFever/30032-02.html.text: Priest Yohanes: Have you met Elias yet? I am sure he is anxiously awaiting your return. Please hurry, the lives of many students are at stake.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30032-note.text: Priest Yohanes: Ah... you are walking a different path from my own. All i can give you are the teaching of Einhasad.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30032.html.text: Priest Yohanes: Welcome to the Temple of Einhasad. I follow here in the footsteps of my father, who was a bishop in the service of Einhasad, the goddess of light . What brings you here today, my friend? Do you wish to devote yourself to her service as well?

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
